title: The Hidden Sharpe Ratio
summary: Gross estimated equity frontier Sharpe about7.4, or5.0 ex microcaps, is not a constructed strategy. Retain a qualified research-tool reference; no return test.
about: Estimating the population maximum Sharpe in high-dimensional managed-portfolio menus without constructing the efficient weights.
findings: Authors estimate annualized gross Sharpe about7.4 for filtered US equities and5.0 excluding microcaps. Corner thresholds pin upper points to lower points in97% of broad-universe rolling windows. No result independently reproduced on market data.
mechanism: Risk premia may lie in low-variance eigendirections suppressed by regularization. Estimating that frontier does not identify executable weights or demonstrate net profit.
build_on: Conditionally useful as a high-dimensional research diagnostic; no source-defined futures signal, native costs or account path. Bounded source/code review completed. No new strategy/data-shopping queue item.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Research-tool code already exists under MIT and was obtained at a pinned commit. No specified tradable7.4-Sharpe portfolio or ES/NQ rule. Faithful inference needs source-matched input matrix, units, assumptions and code parity.

reading_scope.proof_appendices_A_I: not exhaustively reviewed or independently verified

deeper_investigation: Bounded method/implementation investigation completed. No further strategy development from this paper alone; no efficient portfolio or causal futures hypothesis supplied.
